about_the_game:
Every 60s, you are sent back to the starting area and the recording finishes. By starting the loop again, a clone that mimics your past actions will appear, and it will mindlessly act the way you did just 60s ago.

  • You are surrounded. Enemies come from all around you. Killing them will grant you experience that will level up your character. Leveling up unlocks new upgrades, mechanics, playstyles. 

  • Upgrades come in many flavors, with some increasing stats, while others completely changing your way of combating enemies.

DISCLAIMER: The upgrades you obtain will be inherited by future clones. Clones do not discriminate in who they damage, so by taking upgrades that influence nearby creatures, you may influence your future loops. 

The world is not limited to a singular level. Explore and find secrets of all the places overrun by enemies and conquer each one of their kings.

  • The Sewers are an interconnected series of similar rooms that shadow hidden passageways. A shallow mist envelops the area, making it as hard to breathe as it is hard to see. Find your way around the Zombies and cleanse it of all evil.

  • The Desert is a desolate landscape that barely harbors any discernible logic. Dunes, cacti and pyramids give an odd, paranormal feeling about this place. Your enemies here are the Mummies. You will get swarmed, even if it gives them the slightest chance of hiding the secrets of the desert.

  • The Temple is a ruin from a thousand-year-old civilization. The barren forest doesn't feel empty, but more like a barrier preventing access the center piece - a hundred meter behemoth of a structure that has intricate hallways and treasures. Goblins try their best to protect this old structure, but why?

Each of these spaces hides the king of their respective tribe. Do your best and annihilate him before his army grows too large to handle.

Your movements, actions, voice and thoughts are recorded by a mysterious force. By reentering the battle area, an older version of you will be there too, moving, fighting, talking and mindlessly following the past. Will you save your older self from the enslavement of time by ending their misery, or will you use your clones to your advantage?

If you don't want to feel lonely in your first loop, bring up to 3 more friends to help you fight enemies. Of course, their voices are also recorded and repeated by their clones.

And yes, that is you.

short_description: Fight hordes of enemies, upgrade your character and conquer bosses. Be wary of your actions, as each one is recorded and will be played back by an exact replica of you in future loops. Your clones can become either allies by fighting alongside you or they can become enemies by damaging you instead.
